description: This PHP file defines the Gdpr controller class within the Opencart Admin module, responsible for handling GDPR-related email notifications such as export, approval, denial, and removal of user data, including email content generation and task scheduling.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Controller class for handling GDPR-related email notifications within the Opencart admin area, providing methods for exporting data, approving, denying, and removing user data requests, and scheduling email tasks.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to process GDPR actions based on the provided route and arguments, determining which email notification to send.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Generates and schedules an export GDPR email notifying the user about their data export request.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Generates and schedules an approval GDPR email informing the user their request has been approved.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Generates and schedules a denial GDPR email informing the user their request has been denied.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Generates and schedules a removal GDPR email indicating the user's data has been removed.
